name: Ordinary Zobo
description: A smelly Ordinary Zobo.
flavour: Your average 9-to-5 Zobo that shambles into battle with the same energy as clocking in on Monday.

skill.name: Basic Attack
skill.text: Claws at enemies, dealing damage.

name: Two-Headed Zobo
description: A stronger Ordinary Zobo.
flavour: Sure, a two-headed Zobo's scary stuff. But a solo Zobo? Pfft, barely tough!

skill.name: Clobbering Club
skill.text: Swings it's club forcefully, dealing damage.

notes: Boss

name: Tumbleweed Zobo
description: A Grass Zobo whose head keeps fighting even after it's destroyed.
flavour: "Let's split up!" - These were the last words he said to his buddies before he turned into a Zobo.

skill.name: Splitting Heads
skill.text: Throws punches, dealing damage. Upon being knocked down, it's head survives and attacks with it's teeth.

name: Plant Zobo
description: A Grass Zobo who attacks from a distance.
flavour: "A Zobo fused with plants to achieve photosynthesis. Now it sunbathes to live forever!" - Dr. C's Log

skill.name: Veggie Volley
skill.text: Tosses veggie baskets, dealing damage.

name: Clerk Zobo
description: A Grass Zobo that jumps to a neighboring row when hit a certain number of times.
flavour: Unlike the other Zobos, this one is smart enough that it might get promoted to Manager Zobo.

skill.name: Getaway Strike
skill.text: Claws at enemies, dealing damage. After being attacked a certain number of times, leaps to another row.

notes: Gets summoned by the Manager Zobo.

name: Shotgun Zobo
description: A Grass Zobo who deals AoE attacks to enemies in front of it with it's weapon.
flavour: Brought a dusty old gun to a Tatari fight? Seriously? Ten shots won't even scratch Rockzilla.

skill.name: Scattershot
skill.text: Shoots forward, dealing AoE damage.

name: Chemist Zobo
description: A melee Grass Zobo that throws bottles on the ground to heal allies.
flavour: Chemist Zobo abhors machinery. Only alchemy-- or modern chemistry-- is reliable. Isn't that how Garden Zobo was made?

skill.name: Poison Medic
skill.text: Attacks with a vial to deal damage. Spends HP to smash a flask, healing allies in range.

notes: First Zobo to heal other Zobos.

name: Slingshot Zobo
description: A ranged Grass Zobo that shoots deflecting bullets.
flavour: Slingshot Zobo is obsessed with achieving the perfect parabola. Before every projectile attack, it performs lengthy formula calculations to optimize its trajectory. Teaches other Zobos physics as a hobby.

skill.name: Ricochet Shot
skill.text: Shoots bullets to deal damage. On hit, bullets ricochet once to hit another enemy in range.

name: Manager Zobo
description: A powerful Grass Zobo that can summon Clerk Zobos.
flavour: Work your way up to this Zobo, and you'll have an endless brain buffet plus all the pinballs you want!

skill.name: Bloodbound Allies
skill.text: Hurls flower vases, dealing damage. Summons Clerk Zobos. Loses HP when it's summons are knocked down.

notes: Boss; also in Boss Challenge rotation line-up. In the Boss Challenge, they are instead referred to as "Dean Zobo."

name: Shaman Zobo
description: A powerful Grass Zobo who gains shields and calls Hanger-On Zobos to it's aid.
flavour: A traditionalist who won't spend two mana every turn summoning just a random totem. Relax.

skill.name: Ritual Dance
skill.text: Swings bone clubs, dealing damage. Summons Hanger-On Zobos and grants itself Hanger-On: Shield. The shield value decreases when the Hanger-On Zobos die.

notes: Boss; the minions that it summons cannot be fought elsewhere.

name: Garden Zobo
description: A powerful Grass Zobo who entangles enemies.
flavour: Its lab coat looks eerily similar to one worn by a certain researcher, except its pocket is marked with a P, not an A

skill.name: Vine Tangle
skill.text: Shoots seeds, dealing damage. Tosses vines to inflict Garden- Entangled on enemies.

notes: Boss

name: Knight Zobo
description: A Powerful Grass Zobo that does charge attacks.
flavour: The giant! It's making it's final charge towards the giant ahead!

skill.name: Windmill Charge
skill.text: Continuously gains Haste while moving. Its first attack after gaining Haste inflicts Stun and deals massive damage.

notes: Boss

name: Fisherman Zobo
description: A Water Zobo who attacks from a distance.
flavour: There he goes again. Flaunting that fish he caught last year like it's still fresh! (FYI: It's not.)

skill.name: Fish Toss
skill.text: Throws fish, dealing damage.

name: Junker Zobo
description: A Water Zobo who takes less ranged damage.
flavour: "What sets Zobos apart from regular Tatari? They can use car doors as weapons." - Zobo Researcher Chuck

skill.name: Door Smash
skill.text: Smashes with its car door, dealing damage. Takes less damage from ranged attacks.

name: Patient Zobo
description: A Water Zobo that shakes in place when encountering it's enemies.
flavour: This Zobo just shivers in place. Never moves an inch! He's Nurse Zobo's favorite patient to patch up!

skill.name: Fearful Infusion
skill.text: Swings an IV bag, dealing damage. Upon seeing an enemy, trembles with fear.

name: Bugler Zobo
description: A Water Zobo who grants buffs to it's allies.
flavour: It just single-handedly tanked team morale. I need the name of the Zobo who brought it on board. Now!

skill.name: Echo Tones
skill.text: Sounds a horn, granting allies ATK Boost.

name: Surfer Zobo
description: A Water Zobo that moves quickly upon spawning and can stun enemies.
flavour: One of 'em might be Hydro Zobo's ex. You never know.

skill.name: Hang Ten
skill.text: Stomps with its surfboard to deal damage. After appearing, moves quickly to attack and inflict Stun before bouncing back.

name: Yeti Zobo
description: A powerful water Zobo who freezes enemies.
flavour: Left fist hits hard, right fist hits harder. Yeti Zobo is ready for yet another fight!

skill.name: Ice Fury
skill.text: Attacks alternate between light and heavy punches. Heavy punches inflict AoE damage and Freeze. When entering the battlefield, summons a blizzard that deals wide-range AoE damage.

notes: Boss

name: Sailor Zobo
description: A powerful Water Zobo who summons barrels.
flavour: Maybe this Zobo was possessed by a Kraken-like creature? Otherwise, how did an octopus turn from "dinner" into "killer"?

skill.name: Barrel Army
skill.text: Rolls barrels, dealing AoE damage. Summons multiple barrels to deal AoE damage.

notes: Boss

name: Goonch Zobo
description: A water Zobo that jumps between routes to keep you on your toes.
flavour: Looney's "zombies hate water" theory just got fish-slapped by this Zobo. Now pool parties are ruined forever.

skill.name: Slippery Fish
skill.text: Launches an orb of water, dealing damage. Teleports to other rows.

notes: Boss; also in Boss Challenge rotation line-up. In the Boss Challenge, they are instead referred to as "Frankenfish."

name: Rocker Zobo
description: A Lightning Zobo that speeds up when it's weak.
flavour: Those "headphones"? Yeah... they're actually zappy motivators. Who knew zombies could run this fast?

skill.name: Mad Dash
skill.text: Throws punches, dealing damage. At low HP, movement speed is increased.

notes: Gets summoned by the Popstar Zobo.

name: Hockey Zobo
description: A Lightning Zobo that jumps frequently and jumps over Critters after attacking.
flavour: Heads up! This Zobo is playing brain hockey, and your skull's the puck!

skill.name: Ice Waltz
skill.text: Swipes its hockey stick, dealing damage. Periodically leaps to another row.

name: Nurse Zobo
description: A Lightning Zobo that throws syringes to paralyze its targets.
flavour: When a Zobo starts to regain their sanity, this one gives 'em a lil' jab to keep 'em nice and brain-dead!

skill.name: Stunning Syringe
skill.text: Throws syringes, dealing damage and inflicting Paralysis.

notes: She attacks the target 2 blocks away, unlike most ranged Zobos attack the target 1 block away.

name: Battery Zobo
description: A Lightning Zobo who attacks from afar, but switches to melee when weakened.
flavour: It's real job is stealing e-bikes. Before flipping them for cash, it removes the batteries to use as weapons.

skill.name: Low Power
skill.text: Fires small lightning bolts, dealing damage. When at low health, swings a power plug, dealing damage.

name: Arc Punch Zobo
description: A Lightning Zobo that strikes with its fists and unleashes a piercing AoE punch.
flavour: "Referee! I demand a glove inspection!" This Zobo has received a flood of complaints during boxing matches. With high-voltage cables wired to the insides of the gloves, you can guess what happens to the opponents.

skill.name: Lightning Fist
skill.text: Attacks with fists to deal damage. Occasionally throws a piercing punch.

name: Dagger Zobo
description: A Lightning Zobo that throws two daggers at a time. though both can miss.
flavour: Dagger Zobo can't juggle, but can show you a pretty cool (and lethal) knife trick.

skill.name: Knife Trick
skill.text: Throws 2 daggers that often hit different targets to deal damage.

name: Clown Zobo
description: A powerful Lightning Zobo who can leap over enemies as it moves.
flavour: "Sorry, the Zobo you have called is currently piloting a Helicopter. Please call again later."

skill.name: Clown Show
skill.text: Flies onto the battlefield. After landing, uses dual blades to deal damage.

notes: Boss

name: Popstar Zobo
description: A Lightning Zobo that summons a mob of crazed fans.
flavour: This about this. Rocker Zobos just have to dance. Pop Star Zobos have to preform.

skill.name: Superstar
skill.text: Swings it's microphone, dealing damage. Summons Rocker Zobos.

notes: Boss; also in Boss Challenge rotation line-up.

name: Shocker Zobo
description: A powerful Lightning Zobo that can electrify a large area.
flavour: This Zobo will give troublemakers, unruly Tatari, and even you a jolt-tastic wake-up call!

skill.name: Quick Charge
skill.text: Swipes with a defibrillator, dealing damage. Unleashes multiple electric shocks over and increasing distance, dealing AoE damage.

notes: Boss; he releases a large diamond-shaped AoE attack every third attack.

name: Laser Zobo
flavour: Muhaha, fallen Zobos are just what I need to power my reactor, Instant fuel! Max output now!

skill.name: Power Surge
skill.text: Periodically generates cogs nearby, occasionally firing a piercing laser. Collects cogs on the field to increase the laser's duration. When present, other Zobos will drop cogs when they die.

notes: Boss

name: Cowboy Zobo
description: A Rock Zobo who attacks from a distance.
flavour: Even Zobos can't escape their past. This one's still repping the Vanderlinde Logo!

skill.name: Busy Stones
skill.text: Throws stones, dealing damage.

name: Miner Zobo
description: A Rock Zobo that digs tunnels to sneak up behind you.
flavour: Miner mischief! Digging way off the beaten path.

skill.name: Shovel Smash
skill.text: Attacks with a shovel, dealing damage. Upon first meeting an enemy, moves behind it.

name: Digger Zobo
description: A Rock Zobo that digs a large ditch in front of itself upon spawning.
flavour: "This Zobo can drive mine carts. Will they be driving monster trucks next?!" - Dr. C's Log

skill.name: Tunnel Run
skill.text: Attacks with a pickaxe, dealing damage. After appearing, uses tunnels to quickly move a certain distance.

name: Brick Zobo
description: A Rock Zobo with a long attack range who keeps pushing forward.
flavour: Where does it even pull that many bricks from? The sled it's riding sure isn't a pocket dimension.

skill.name: Paved Path
skill.text: Tosses bricks, dealing damage. Movement is replaced by a forward slide.

name: Trekker Zobo
description: A ranged Rock Zobo that speeds up its allies.
flavour: "It's been observed through Trekker Zobo that calorie-dense foods allow Zobos to sprint a short distance." --Unnamed Log

skill.name: Chocolate Mountain
skill.text: Throws a trekking pole to deal damage. Tosses chocolate to allies, granting them Haste.

name: Ripper Zobo
description: A Rock Zobo that heals itself through attacks.
flavour: To stay warm on chilly peaks, hiking enthusiast Ripper Zobo wraps itself tight like a mummy, leaving only the eyes exposed. Ice axes just might be too annoying to use on the cliffs though. How about a massive fanged jaw to latch onto things?

skill.name: Leeching Bite
skill.text: Chomps down to deal damage. Heals itself based on the damage dealt.

name: Sandworm Zobo
description: A powerful Rock Zobo who relocates the enemy.
flavour: Everyone thought Zobos would always be humanoid. Until this one slithered in. Ah, natural wonders.

skill.name: Sand Control
skill.text: Spits mud bullets, dealing damage. Uses quicksand to reposition enemies.

notes: Boss

name: Climber Zobo
description: A powerful Rock Zobo who can target multiple zones.
flavour: It could once hook a Tatari with its axe over for a beatdown. Devs removed the skill... for the bigger picture.

skill.name: Tremor
skill.text: Swings a pickaxe, dealing damage and causing the ground to shake, periodically dealing AoE damage.

notes: Boss

name: Roadhog Zobo
description: A Rock Zobo that smashes through everything in its way.
flavour: Count yourself lucky that he's only coming at you with a tire. It could've been a whole truck!

skill.name: Tire Swing
skill.text: Swings a heavy tire, dealing AoE damage. Unleashes a three-hit combo to smash enemies.

notes: Boss; also in Boss Challenge rotation line-up. Can use 1-time-only ability to damage and bypass a Tatari blocking his way. In the Boss Challenge, they are instead referred to as "Road Bully."

name: Pharaoh Zobo
description: A powerful Rock Zobo whose attacks become more devastating over time.
flavour: "Doesn't it get tired from shooting beams all day?" "That's how it was designed. No stopping until you die!" --Dev Chat

skill.name: Death Curse
skill.text: Summons multiple attackable coffins and appears from the last one destroyed. Applies a death curse which repeatedly inflicts Fragile that stacks.

notes: Boss, is also the first Boss Zobo that can spawn from any 5 lanes.

name: Firehead Zobo
description: A Fire Zobo that runs fast but slows down when weakened.
flavour: This Zobos's life goals: (1) Hoard pinballs (2) Buy a bike (3) Legally change name to "Johnny Blazer."

skill.name: Draining Blow
skill.text: Swings forcefully, dealing damage. At low HP, Movement Speed is reduced.

name: Matchstick Zobo
description: A Fire Zobo that explodes when destroyed.
flavour: "ART IS A BLAZING BOOM!"

skill.name: Spark Tome
skill.text: Slashes with a matchstick, dealing damage. Detonates upon being knocked down, dealing limited AoE damage.

notes: Gets summoned by the Tipsy Zobo.

name: Landlady Zobo
description: A Fire Zobo that attacks from a distance.
flavour: "Oh honey, turning into a Zobo doesn't mean that rent's free. HEY! WHO THREW A DANG FIRE EXTINGUISHER?!"

skill.name: Fire Control
skill.text: Tosses fire extinguishers, dealing damage.

notes: May inflict Burn status to Tatari.

name: Kindling Zobo
description: A Fire Zobo who tosses hot stones and flaming stones that inflict Burning.
flavour: Throwing rocks still hurts? Well... Nurse Zobos use syringes, so this makes sense.

skill.name: Hot Stones
skill.text: Tosses hot stones, dealing damage. After a certain number of attacks, tosses flaming stones, inflicting damage and Burning.

name: Bombard Zobo
description: A Fire Zobo that throws bombs to deal damage.
flavour: Bombard Zobo saves the best part for last by cooking a bomb and throwing it in one second before detonation. This exhilarating game of gamble has cost Bombard Zobo more than a few teammates.

skill.name: Blaze Bomb
skill.text: Throws a bomb that detonates after a delay.

name: Barrel Zobo
description: A Fire Zobo that hides inside a barrel to avoid danger.
flavour: The world outside is too chaotic, and the Zobo Horde is just overwhelming. Only inside a barrel does Barrel Zobo find peace.

skill.name: Barrel Barrier
skill.text: Attacks with its fists to deal damage. When HP is low, hides inside a barrel for a while and gains DEF Boost.

name: Volcano Zobo
description: A powerful Fire Zobo who explodes multiple times and revives.
flavour: "ART IS..." Wait, that line's been taken, and it's a big, active VOLCANO, you know. "ART IS AN EXPLOSION!"

skill.name: Magma Slam
skill.text: Swings stone fists, dealing AoE damage. Upon being destroyed the first few times, explodes to deal AoE damage, then resurrects.

notes: Boss; explodes 3 times, reviving twice.

name: Forge Zobo
description: A powerful Fire Zobo who launches other zobos.
flavour: The limits and constraints imposed by ordinary feeble bodies are simply unacceptable. Glorious Evolution!

skill.name: Flame Toss
skill.text: Launches fireballs, dealing damage. Pulls allies, then launches them.

notes: Boss

name: Tipsy Zobo
description: A powerful Fire Zobo who buffs other Zobos.
flavour: Zobologist Billy Babbo discovered that Zobos are much bolder after a drink because of their DNA.

skill.name: Brothers All
skill.text: Hurls wine bottles, dealing damage. Inspires all Zobos, granting Haste and DMG Boost.

notes: Boss; also in Boss Challenge rotation line-up.

name: Captain Zobo
description: A Fire Zobo that can switch between attack modes.
flavour: For Captain Zobo, not all treasure is silver and gold.

skill.name: Pistol Diplomacy
skill.text: Fires its weapon to attack at range, generating gold coins. When coins are picked up, recovers HP and gains ATK Boost, before switching to a blade for melee attacks.

notes: Boss, also seems to appear every x-80 level in each chapter.
